_: The mutant guard's allowlist (tools/lib/mutants.test.mjs). computed: a mutation whose needle the guard can't read statically, keyed by the call's text. exempt: a literal the guard reads as a needle that isn't one in a file. rotted: a needle known not to bite, reported and waiting for its check's owner; the guard fails when it bites again, so the entry comes off. Every entry carries its reason, and an entry that matches nothing fails the guard.
